fields.name: publicApiVersions
fields.description: The list of public Partner API versions, including supported, release candidate and unstable versions.

fields.name: transactions
fields.description: A list of the Partner organization's [transactions](https://help.shopify.com/partners/getting-started/getting-paid).

args.name: after
args.description: Returns the elements in the list that come after the specified cursor.

args.name: before
args.description: Returns the elements in the list that come before the specified cursor.

args.name: first
args.description: Returns the first _n_ elements from the list.

args.name: last
args.description: Returns the last _n_ elements from the list.

args.name: shopId
args.description: Returns transactions associated with the specified shop ID.

args.name: myshopifyDomain
args.description: Returns transactions associated with the specified `.myshopify.com` shop domain. Example value: `example.myshopify.com`.

args.name: appId
args.description: Returns transactions associated with the specified app ID.

args.name: createdAtMin
args.description: Returns transactions that were created on or after the specified date and time.

args.name: createdAtMax
args.description: Returns transactions that were created on or before the specified date and time.

args.name: types
args.description: Returns transactions of the specified types.

possibleTypes.name: AppOneTimeSale
possibleTypes.description: A transaction corresponding to a one-time app charge.

possibleTypes.name: AppSaleAdjustment
possibleTypes.description: A transaction corresponding to a refund, downgrade, or adjustment of an app charge.

possibleTypes.name: AppSubscriptionSale
possibleTypes.description: A transaction corresponding to an app subscription charge.

possibleTypes.name: AppUsageSale
possibleTypes.description: A transaction corresponding to an app usage charge.

possibleTypes.name: LegacyTransaction
possibleTypes.description: A transaction of a type that is no longer supported.

possibleTypes.name: ReferralAdjustment
possibleTypes.description: A transaction corresponding to a shop referral adjustment.

possibleTypes.name: ReferralTransaction
possibleTypes.description: A transaction corresponding to a shop referral.

possibleTypes.name: ServiceSale
possibleTypes.description: A transaction corresponding to a paid invoice for a service.

possibleTypes.name: ServiceSaleAdjustment
possibleTypes.description: A transaction corresponding to a refund, downgrade, or adjustment of a service sale.

possibleTypes.name: TaxTransaction
possibleTypes.description:
Tax transactions are not computed for pending transactions. Instead, they're rolled
up as one transaction per payout. The type of tax and the way it's
computed is dependent on the type of transaction.

For sale transactions, such as app subscriptions or theme purchases, Shopify charges
the Partner tax on the fee collected for brokering the transaction. The amount is
a negative number in this scenario.

For referral transactions, such as a development store transfer, Shopify pays the Partner
a commission. The tax represents any taxes on the referral commission that are payable to
the Partner. The amount is a positive number in this scenario.

possibleTypes.name: ThemeSale
possibleTypes.description: A transaction corresponding to a theme purchase.

possibleTypes.name: ThemeSaleAdjustment
possibleTypes.description: A transaction corresponding to a refund, downgrade, or adjustment of a theme sale.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The ID of the app. Example value: `gid://partners/App/1234`.
